correctness.rationale: Reconstructed both the 2-/3-subset incidence graph of [5] and GP(10,3) independently: a NetworkX VF2 isomorphism exists; both have 20 vertices, 30 edges, diameter 5, distance-shell pair counts 30/60/60/30/10. Independent r=2/r=3 clique f-vectors (20,90,120,30) and (20,150,540,1000,960,450,80). As a separate direct certificate of the hard scale-three homotopy, independently replayed the publicly available explicit GP(10,3) Morse order on the actual graph: 1599 matched pairs and 13980 oriented covers, acyclic, exactly one critical vertex and one critical 3-cell; r=2 similarly gives 120 pairs, 660 covers, one vertex and nineteen 2-cells. This corroborates the submitted original alternative collapse/integral-chain argument without claiming to have rerun all its 409 integer pivots. Ten farthest-distance antipodal pairs give S^9 at r=4; diameter 5 yields the final simplex.
residual_risks: This verification is finite for the stated graph, not a graph-family theorem.
Original verify_desargues.py 409-pivot reduction was inspected but not executed; an independent alternate 1599-pair acyclic Morse certificate established the same stage-three conclusion.

evidence: Feng–Nukala Theorem 13 implies exactly the scale-two 19S2 term after recognizing subset symmetric difference, but it does not cover scale 3/4. The independently published complete GP(10,3) filtration, however, is strictly sufficient to cover the entire submitted claim.
